chunks.label: Girls boys men women
chunks.rationale: Lets you point out and describe the people around you.
chunks.interference: ko (child) vs hito (person); onna no ko can still mean a young woman.

chunks.label: Babies kids and age
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about babies, kids, young people and who is older.
chunks.interference: gaki is rude; the neutral word for a kid is kodomo.

chunks.label: Students and classmates
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about the people you studied with.
chunks.interference: gakusei is mostly university students; seito is school pupils.

chunks.label: School stages
chunks.rationale: Lets you say what stage of school someone is in.

chunks.label: Plans and occasions
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about plans, this time, today and the other day.
chunks.interference: honjitsu and senjitsu are formal; in chat use kyou and kono aida.

chunks.label: Friends and rivals
chunks.rationale: Lets you say who is close to you or on your side.
chunks.interference: yuujin is the formal tomodachi; mikata also means 'way of seeing'.

chunks.label: Partners and cheating
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about dating, cheating and being single.
chunks.interference: uwaki is cheating in general; furin involves a married person.

chunks.label: Life and living
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about your life, its chances, struggles and memories.
chunks.interference: jinsei is life as a whole; seikatsu is daily living.

chunks.label: Boss and coworkers
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about the people you work with.
chunks.interference: joushi is above you, buka below you, douryou beside you.

chunks.label: Customers and crowds
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about customers, a crowd, or the person in question.
chunks.interference: kyaku alone sounds blunt; okyakusan is the everyday form.

chunks.label: Types of people
chunks.rationale: Lets you call someone good-looking, gifted, rich or a beginner.
chunks.interference: bijin is for women, ikemen for men.

chunks.label: Teams and groups
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about groups and the roles in them.

chunks.label: Titles at work
chunks.rationale: Job titles that also work as names to call someone by.
chunks.interference: buchou ranks above kachou; mixing them up is awkward.

chunks.label: Men and women by setting
chunks.rationale: Words for men and women in formal, group and rough talk.
chunks.interference: dansei is formal and ossan is rude; joshi and danshi are casual group words.

chunks.label: Past present and future
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about the past, the present and the future.
chunks.interference: mirai is the big future; your own future is shourai.

chunks.label: Pointing to a time
chunks.rationale: Lets you place events in time: back when, before, from now, the moment.
chunks.interference: izen and kongo are a bit formal; in chat use mae and kore kara.
